Segmented mirror scan: exact retained lattice

The tile radius is span=R/5. Integer q,r place centres at
  x = 1.5*span*q
  z = sqrt(3)*span*(r+q/2).
A centre survives only when hypot(x,z)+span <= R. In exact arithmetic,
this is 3*(q*q+q*r+r*r) <= 16. Equality is impossible: the left side is
an integer multiple of three. The nearest squared values on either side
are at most 15 and at least 18. Their radial margin exceeds .127 spans,
or .025 of R.

For R >= 2^-600, every nonzero radial-cull operand is normal binary64,
including span. The height calculation does not enter this test. Go Hypot
rescales by the larger operand before squaring. A conservative 512*u*R
rounding envelope for this short, noncancelling pipeline is far smaller
than the lattice margin. The > to >= mutation therefore retains the same
tiles.

A retained tile has |q|<=2. Already at |q|=3, |x|+span=5.5 spans > R.
For those surviving columns, every |r|>=5 row is outside the disc. Adding
q=-5 or q=5, removing q=4, adding r=-6 or r=6, or removing r=5 changes
only discarded scan points.

Replacing r+q/2 with r-q/2 reindexes r by r-q. The padded row range still
contains every retained centre in each column. These are small exact
half-integer sums; matching centres have bit-identical coordinates and
remain in the same order. There are 19 retained centres.

The public Optical API permits arbitrarily small positive apertures, so
normal radial arithmetic alone is not the whole argument. For R<2^-600,
Aperture A=2R<2^-599, including R=0 after division underflow. The first
structure box has width=depth=.35A. Its top triangles have equal Y values
and horizontal edge components bounded by A after azimuth rotation. Every
cross component is bounded by 2*A*A<2^-1197 and underflows to zero.
mesh.New refuses that leaf surface, if the enclosure has not failed first.

Material slots are meshed in order: enclosure 0, structure 1, mirror 2.
The changed mirror faces are not exposed before that identical error.
Bounds is prescribed metadata, and Lights is empty. Even the fully padded
scan has only 99*24 faces, below the unchanged 100000-face cap together
with the fixed enclosure. No minimum aperture from YAML is assumed.

This covers the exact eight recorded padding, reindexing and cull mutations.
It does not cover arbitrary mirror edits or the quad area threshold. Review
again if public construction, slot order, storage access or the numerical
implementation changes. Source hashes are recorded below.
